LESSON: WISE MEN

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The
Topic 3.1: Wise men

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Wise men. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

You will learn the key ideas about Wise men and use them at home and at school.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

Read about Wise men with your parent or teacher. Say what it means in your own words.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Wise men.
2. Explain Wise men to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Wise men.
4. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Wise men. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Wise men important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Wise men is important in everyday life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
